messages:
Emi J. (People Ops): Thread to coordinate onsite for Marcelo Souza in our So Paulo office on Mon Feb 8. Hes arriving GRU 06:15 from Recife. Needs: accessible desk (wheelchair), halal lunch, airport pickup option, visitor badge, and expense guidance for BRL receipts.
Carlos M. (Recruiter): Marcelo asked for a 10:00 start to recover from the flight. Prefers a single long loop 10:00-13:00 if possible. He confirmed wheelchair assistance at the airport.
Harper L. (Hiring Manager): 10:00-13:00 works for me. Will split 90m technical + 30m culture. Panel please join 5-10 min early.
Rafa P. (Office Admin): I can reserve Sala Alpha + Quiet Room. Will prepare an adjustable-height desk, wheelchair ramp route, and a halal boxed lunch. Need full name for badge and plate if he drives.
Carlos M. (Recruiter): Sending candidate the questions about parking and whether he wants the company pickup (driver will wait at arrivals). Also told him we reimburse transit up to BRL 300.
Emi J. (People Ops): Reimbursement reminder: originals preferred; photos accepted. For BRL receipts include a short conversion note: "amount in BRL, converted to USD at xe.com on date". Submit to travel@redwood.example within 30 days. Taxi cap GRU->office pre-approved up to BRL 300.
travel-bot: Calendar event created: "Onsite  Marcelo Souza" Mon Feb 8 10:00-13:00 BRT  https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=sp123 (rooms: Sala Alpha + Quiet Room, pickup option: driver@redwood.example).
Rafa P. (Office Admin): Badge preparsed under "Marcelo Souza". Halal lunch ordered for 12:00. Wheelchair route maps and signage printed.
Carlos M. (Recruiter): Marcelo confirmed pickup and gave plate "BRA-1234" for permit. I'll send final itinerary + pickup details 24h prior and CC travel@redwood.example.
Emi J. (People Ops): Day-of checklist: 1) Confirm pickup time & driver contact, 2) Ensure accessible desk & Quiet Room ready, 3) Send itinerary + Meet fallback if customs/delays, 4) Remind candidate about receipts/email to travel@redwood.example.
Harper L. (Hiring Manager): I'll be there early and bring a spare HDMI dongle. Thanks everyone.
Carlos M. (Recruiter): Finalizing message to Marcelo now. Marking this thread for day-of updates. :thumbsup:
